ns2:section.sectionText: For Sustainable Design majors only. Prior approval of internship is required; students are encouraged to inquire early whether an internship is eligible. Internships should be relevant to the field of Sustainable Design and may be paid or unpaid. Registration only with instructor permission (submit your internship job description and offer letter to sustaindesign@illinois.edu prior to the 1st day of class). Course is zero credit hours and graded as Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory.
